name: Powdery false cloak fern
desc: Powdery false cloak fern (Argyrochosma dealbata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Argyrochosma dealbata, the powdery false cloak fern, is a small fern endemic to the central and southern United States. It grows on calcareous rocks, such as limestone.
